source_caption_text:
Don Toliver previewed “She Just Wanna Party” from his upcoming album “Nitrous” at an after-party in Italy ⛽️🔥

The new snippet follows a run of unreleased previews during the European leg of his Octane World Tour. Don has been building anticipation onstage, telling fans, “When I drop this new album… JUST WATCH,” and giving audiences an early taste of what he’s working on.

“Nitrous” follows “OCTANE,” which earned Don his first No. 1 on the Billboard 200 earlier this year with 162,000 first-week album-equivalent units—his biggest opening yet.

An official release date for “Nitrous” hasn’t been announced, but Don is keeping the new music coming through these previews 👀

How’s “She Just Wanna Party” sounding? 🔊👇
